checks.command: sh -c 'cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf "{bad" > .todolist.json && for c in list count completed "add t1 x" "done t1" "remove t1"; do node "$OLDPWD/src/cli.mjs" $c >o 2>e; test $? -eq 1 && test ! -s o && test "$(wc -l <e)" -eq 1 && grep -q "^error:.*state file" e || exit 1; done && printf "{bad" | cmp -s - .todolist.json'
checks.name: corrupt-repro

summary: Independently reproduced TK-004: with a corrupt .todolist.json every command (list, count, completed, add, done, remove) prints exactly one stderr line 'error: state file contains invalid JSON', writes nothing to stdout, exits 1, and leaves the corrupt bytes untouched; with a valid file add/list/count/done/completed/remove behave as before (existing 13 tests plus 2 new pass, 15/15 via node scripts/verify.mjs and node --test). docs/product/todolist.md documents the corrupt-file behavior under Managing todos and documentation_validation receipt rcpt_01M1VWTCEQSY2Z80KF8T0WYKTD binds its current hash sha256:0378ddd3 and commit c3778da for DOC-TODOLIST-BEHAVIOR revision 1.
